text: Cooling and heating loads shall be calculated with a transient method (or the ASHRAE heat balance method) and include: equipment heat release from the electrical load list (heat losses of transformers, switchgear, UPS, chargers, drives, DCS cabinets), lighting, occupants, solar and conduction gains and fresh air; a 10 % design margin and a 5 % allowance for future additions shall be added to the calculated loads; the equipment heat release shall be taken from the equipment records and the electrical load list, not retyped.
